sourceTitle: Sir Ludar A Story of the Days of the Great Queen Bess
description: "Sir Ludar" by Talbot Baines Reed is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. Set in the late sixteenth century during the reign of Queen Elizabeth I, the story follows the adventurous and spirited Humphrey Dexter, an apprentice printer who finds himself caught up in a series of escapades involving loyalty to the Queen, youthful rivalry, and unexpected encounters with strangers.
